name: Ground vehicle (2D kinematic)
description: A generic unarmed ground vehicle driving to a waypoint in a 2D world. The controller sees only noisy or missing GPS observations; the lab injects GPS dropouts and actuator faults and checks temporal contracts and safety invariants on the true position.

protected.reason: held-out seeds of the M6 controller repair experiment (scenarios/m6/experiment.json); running them here would spend the evaluation set
reserved for a future preregistered confirmation; never run before the owner freezes and authorises that protocol

model_validity: 2D kinematic model: integer-millimetre positions, fixed 100 ms ticks, a fixed step per movement command. No dynamics, inertia, steering, terrain or environment. The results describe the logic of the controller and the monitors, not a physical vehicle.
